signal: Resource Data competes in custom software and data engineering, where pipeline depends on reaching technical buyers faster than the team can cover

email.subject1: a signal play for Resource Data
email.body1:
Ariel, reaching out because at a custom software and data shop like Resource Data, sales and marketing usually has more in-market accounts than the team can cover without adding reps.

That gap is where pipeline quietly leaks, especially when reps burn time on research and follow-up instead of conversations. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Resource Data off your tech-stack and hiring signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ariel, quick follow-up for Resource Data.

In services, every rep can only cover so many accounts, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit target. The gap shows up late, and by then the quarter is a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Resource Data needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ariel, last bit of proof for Resource Data.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Resource Data's reply rate likely compares to other software-services teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ariel, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running both sales and marketing is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a software-services motion? I will tailor it to Resource Data either way.
